en.Pixel: One position in an image grid.
en.Channel: One measurement type at every pixel, such as red.
en.Shape: The sizes of an array along its axes.
en.RGB: A colour representation using red, green and blue channels.
en.Hue: A colour family such as red or blue.
en.Saturation: How strongly coloured a pixel is relative to grey.
en.Kernel: A small table of weights or neighbourhood positions.
en.Padding: Values supplied beyond the original image border.
en.Weighted sum: Multiply each value by its weight and add the results.
en.Edge: A location where nearby image values change strongly.
en.Erosion: Keep only positions whose required neighbours are all selected.
en.Dilation: Select positions with at least one selected required neighbour.
en.Bounding box: A rectangle around an object, recorded by its corners.
en.Interpolation: Estimating a value between known sample positions.
en.Augmentation: Making changed training examples while keeping targets consistent.
en.Keypoint: A selected location whose neighbourhood is useful to compare.
en.Descriptor: A numerical summary of a local image region.
en.Euclidean distance: Square-root of the sum of squared entry differences.
en.Feature: A number that captures a useful property of an input.
en.Weight: A multiplier whose value can be learned from examples.
en.Loss: A numerical penalty for disagreement with a target.
en.Softmax: Exponentiate scores and divide by their sum.
en.IoU: Shared area divided by total covered area.
en.Suppression: Removing a lower-scoring candidate under a rule.
en.AP: A summary of precision as recall increases, with a specified convention.
en.Matching threshold: The minimum overlap required to pair a prediction with a reference.
en.Mask: A pixel grid storing a selection or a class label.
en.Foreground: The region selected as relevant to the task.
en.Instance: One individual object, such as one of three leaves.
en.Track: An identity and changing state linked across frames.
en.Association: Pairing a new detection with an existing track.
en.Occlusion: An object is partly or fully hidden from the camera.
en.OCR: Converting visible text in an image into character data.
en.Template: A stored example used for comparison.
en.Reading order: The order in which page regions should be read.
en.Patch: A small grid region cut from an image.
en.Token: One numerical unit processed in a sequence.
en.Projection: Weighted sums that convert one feature list to another size.
en.Self-attention: Mixing information among tokens in the same sequence.
en.Anomaly: An observation unlike the reference examples.
en.Defect: A problem defined by the actual inspection task.
en.Baseline: A simple method used as a comparison point.
en.Precision: Correct alerts divided by all alerts.
en.Recall: Found real items divided by all real items.
en.Leakage: Test information reaches model development and makes evaluation misleading.
en.Domain shift: The data conditions change between development and use.
en.Inference: Making predictions with a model’s current fixed weights.
en.Latency: Time a request waits until its result is ready.
en.Quantization: Representing values with a smaller set of possible numbers.
en.Throughput: The number of completed requests per unit time.

zh.像素: 图像网格中的一个位置。
zh.通道: 每个像素的一种测量类型，例如红色。
zh.RGB: 使用红、绿、蓝通道的颜色表示。
zh.饱和度: 相对于灰色，像素颜色的强烈程度。
zh.核: 小型权重表或邻域位置表。
zh.填充: 在原图边界外补充的数值。
zh.加权和: 每个数乘权重后再相加。
zh.边缘: 邻近图像数值明显变化的位置。
zh.腐蚀: 只保留所需邻居全部被选中的位置。
zh.膨胀: 只要所需邻居有一个被选中，就选中该位置。
zh.边界框: 用角点记录的包围物体的矩形。
zh.插值: 估计已知采样位置之间的数值。
zh.数据增强: 改变训练样本，同时保持目标一致。
zh.关键点: 周围区域值得比较的选中位置。
zh.描述子: 图像局部区域的数值摘要。
zh.欧几里得距离: 对应元素差平方之和的平方根。
zh.特征: 描述输入某种有用性质的数。
zh.权重: 可以从样本中学习的乘数。
zh.损失: 输出与目标不符时的数值惩罚。
zh.Softmax: 对分数取指数，再除以总和。
zh.交并比: 共享面积除以总覆盖面积。
zh.抑制: 按规则删除较低分候选项。
zh.平均精确率: 按指定约定概括召回率增加时的精确率。
zh.匹配阈值: 把预测与参考配对所需的最小重叠。
zh.掩码: 保存选中状态或类别标签的像素网格。
zh.前景: 任务关注并选中的区域。
zh.实例: 一个独立物体，例如三片叶子中的一片。
zh.轨迹: 跨帧连接的身份及变化状态。
zh.关联: 将新检测与已有轨迹配对。
zh.遮挡: 物体被部分或完全遮住。
zh.光学字符识别: 把图像中的可见文字变为字符数据。
zh.模板: 用于比较的已存参考样本。
zh.阅读顺序: 页面各区域应被阅读的次序。
zh.图像块: 从图像切出的一个小网格区域。
zh.词元: 序列中被处理的一个数值单元。
zh.投影: 用加权和把特征列表转换到另一种大小。
zh.自注意力: 在同一序列的词元之间混合信息。
zh.异常: 与参考样本不同的观察。
zh.缺陷: 由实际检查任务定义的问题。
zh.基线: 作为比较起点的简单方法。
zh.精确率: 正确警报数除以全部警报数。
zh.召回率: 找到的真实目标数除以全部真实目标数。
zh.信息泄漏: 测试信息进入模型开发，使评估产生误导。
zh.领域偏移: 开发与使用时的数据条件不同。
zh.推理: 使用当前固定权重作预测。
zh.延迟: 一个请求等待结果的时间。
zh.量化: 用更少种可能数值表示数据。
zh.吞吐量: 单位时间完成的请求数量。
